# Real delimited fixtures

Samples from actual bespoke jobs, redacted or synthesised-equivalent
when the original contains PII. Used by
`Streamline.Files.Delimited.Tests` and end-to-end tests in
`Streamline.Integration.Tests`.

**Populated in Phase 3.** Empty today.

Every fixture that lands here must have a one-line entry added to
this README describing:

- what the file is (source job, format)
- what pathology it exercises
- which test references it

See `docs/TESTING.md` for the rules on fixture hygiene.
